title: Independent reading: 1 Thessalonians 1:2–10
subtitle: Read thanksgiving, report, and imitation in epistle prose.
overview: Paul’s thanksgiving introduces participial descriptions, a report of reception, and the Thessalonians’ response. Map the repeated μνείαν, ἔργον, and λόγος language.
This paragraph trains you to distinguish the letter writer’s present thanksgiving from the reported past actions of the recipients.

items.grc: εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν.
items.en: We give thanks to God always concerning all of you.

items.grc: καὶ ὑμεῖς μιμηταὶ ἡμῶν ἐγενήθητε καὶ τοῦ κυρίου.
items.en: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord.
